page_title: ANG 2-0 LOR | Angers v Lorient 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Benoit Bastien is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' The game is interrupted as Sambou Soumano (Lorient) is flagged offside.
90+2' A cross into the box finds the head of Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) who steers it goalwards, but Herve Koffi manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lanroy Machine (Angers) smashes the ball with a volley from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
89' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacques Ekomie (Angers) replacing Himad Abdelli.
89' The referee allows time for a substitution. Yassine Belkhdim will be replaced by Marius Courcoul (Angers).
88' Dermane Karim (Lorient) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
86' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:6.
83' The foul by Theo Le Bris (Lorient) was seen by Benoit Bastien who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
82' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
80' Lorient are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
78' Noah Cadiou (Lorient) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Laurent Abergel.
77' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle. Dermane Karim (Lorient) commits a foul after dangerous play.
75' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Jordan Lefort (Angers) for a tough tackle.
74' The corner kick picks out Dermane Karim (Lorient) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
74' Lorient take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
73' A free kick into the box, taken by Arthur Avom (Lorient), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Lorient win a corner kick.
73' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
71' The players claim that Sidiki Cherif (Angers) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Dermane Karim (Lorient) is replacing Jean-Victor Makengo.
65' Substitution. Pablo Pagis did his best and is replaced by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient).
65' Substitution. Aiyegun Tosin makes his way off the pitch and Sambou Soumano (Lorient) comes on as his replacement.
65' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Louis Mouton will be replaced by Lanroy Machine (Angers).
65' Here comes a substitution. Amine Sbai is given a rest as he is replaced by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
62' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
59' 2 - 0 Sidiki Cherif (Angers) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Yvon Mvogo with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0.
58' That's unlucky! Louis Mouton (Angers) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Angers comes to nothing.
55' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pablo Pagis (Lorient). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
53' Benoit Bastien has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ousmane Camara (Angers).
52' Angers hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
50' Florent Hanin (Angers) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.
49' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Bamo Meite is replaced by Igor Silva (Lorient).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Arthur Avom (Lorient) cracks a volley from just outside the box and his bad shot goes way wide of the right post. It will be a goal kick.
45+2' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Louis Mouton (Angers) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
42' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) but poses no threat.
39' Arthur Avom (Lorient) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
36' Looks like Arthur Avom (Lorient) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
36' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
33' Some neat passing and movement from Lorient as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
30' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
29' The percentage of ball possession is – 40:60.
28' Alexandre Dujeux is forced to make a change. Prosper Peter is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Sidiki Cherif (Angers).

27' Amine Sbai (Angers) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Yvon Mvogo, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
26' Prosper Peter (Angers) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
24' Prosper Peter (Angers) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Herve Koffi anticipates the direction of the penalty by Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient). He attempted to put the ball inside the right post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
22' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
21' Carlens Arcus (Angers) makes a slide tackle, but referee Benoit Bastien blows for a foul. It's a penalty! Lorient have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
18' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and it's Prosper Peter (Angers) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
16' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Amine Sbai laid the ball off to Prosper Peter (Angers), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
13' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
10' Amine Sbai (Angers) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yvon Mvogo.
8' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
6' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies miles over the crossbar. Very poor shot.
6' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) takes the corner which is cleared.
5' Wow, what an escape. Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Lorient force their opponents to concede a corner.
3' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
3' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lorient.
3' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
2' Lorient are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
2' Jordan Lefort (Angers) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Angers will kick the game off.
Benoit Bastien will referee today's match.
